description: Phase B population run, REWRITTEN under D4(a) (docs/DECISION-D4-CLDF-AND-WIKIBASE.md §2; ROADMAP.md Phase B). The original version of this tasklist treated the CLDF ingest as an incremental top-up on a hand-curated spine of 1,099 languages and 543 families. D4 inverts that: the published CLDF releases become the SUBSTRATE and curation is reserved for what nobody publishes. So this run executes the acquisitions at their real scale — Glottolog 5.x (~8,600 language-level languoids inside ~26k total languoids, with the DESCENDS_FROM genealogy the 543 curated family rows approximate), the 118 Grambank/Concepticon specs, the 108 DBpedia dbo:influencedBy edge pull, and the 109 range-polygon push past 133/200 — landing everything through 117's ADMISSION-TIME licence tiering, then re-baselining convergence-QA and regenerating every pinned snapshot the data change cascades into (docs/{engine-export-manifest,reconciliation-report,coverage-report,corpus-tier-report}.json + the lugh-checkout manifests, per the scripts/CLAUDE.md regeneration matrix). TWO CORRECTIONS carried from the D4 review: Glottolog is CC-BY-4.0, NOT CC-BY-SA-3.0 as the superseded version of this file and 107's description both stated — it belongs in the permissive core, and mis-stamping it as share-alike would have propagated a duty the licence does not impose; and no acquisition may land before 117, because a row's tier must be stored at admission and cannot be repaired downstream. NETWORK REALITY, stated honestly: the acquisition steps need live egress (glottolog.org/Zenodo, the Grambank/Concepticon releases, the DBpedia endpoint, Wikidata WDQS) — an agent runner without egress cannot perform them. The house pattern holds regardless: the networked step writes committed scripts/data/*-additions TSVs (or fixture-committed dump extracts) that are the network-free replay source, so CI and the verify gate never touch the network; if the runner lacks egress, the acquire step is run human-side and the tasklist lands + verifies the committed artifacts. Scope: acquisition runs, committed data TSVs, snapshot/baseline regeneration, coverage verification. Retiring the hand-curated rows these ingests supersede is 119, deliberately separate so the ingest can be reviewed before anything curated is displaced.

userStories.title: Run the Glottolog CLDF ingest at substrate scale
userStories.description: Execute the 107 Glottolog spec against a real Glottolog 5.x CLDF release as the language/family SUBSTRATE — not a top-up — landing the genealogy and the glottocode-anchored languoids through the write-back cascade with 117's admission-time licence tiering applied.
acceptanceCriteria: The 107 Glottolog spec is executed against a real Glottolog 5.x release (requires egress to glottolog.org/Zenodo; if the runner has none, the download/acquire step is performed human-side and this story lands + verifies its committed output), producing DESCENDS_FROM genealogy edges and glottocode-anchored languoid nodes at real scale — the run records the languoid, language-level, family, and edge counts (order ~8,600 language-level inside ~26k total languoids), not a fixture-sized result.

Every ingested record carries `CC-BY-4.0` (Glottolog's actual licence — NOT CC-BY-SA) plus Glottolog provenance and no fabricated URLs, is admitted through 117's ingest gate into the permissive core tier, and the committed acquisition TSV under scripts/data/ is the network-free replay source.

Reconciliation against the existing corpus runs the glottocode -> ISO 639-3 two-key cascade (engine/src/pinakes_engine/schema/glottolog_reconcile.py) and reports matched / ambiguous / new; ambiguous is never auto-merged and no curated cell is overwritten — the run records how many of the 1,099 curated language rows and 543 family rows Glottolog matches, which is the input 119 acts on.

`bun run convergence-qa` passes on the grown corpus (attribution + dedup-ratchet green, re-baselined via `bun run convergence-qa:baseline` only where counts legitimately move), and `.chief/verify.sh` passes.

userStories.title: Run the typology, etymology-adjacent, and geometry acquisitions
userStories.description: Execute the remaining Phase-B acquisitions on top of the Glottolog spine: the 118 Grambank (and, if its licence cleared, Concepticon) ingests, the 108 DBpedia dbo:influencedBy pull, and the 109 range-polygon source — each landing in the tier its licence entitles it to.
acceptanceCriteria: The 118 Grambank ingest is executed against a real release, landing grammatical-feature facts keyed by glottocode at real scale (order 195 features x 2,400+ languages) with per-record CC-BY provenance, and its per-language coverage report is committed; Concepticon is run only if 118 US-1 cleared its licence, and is recorded as deferred with the reason if not.

The 108 DBpedia adapter is executed against the live endpoint/dump (egress caveat as US-1), landing INFLUENCED_BY edges that reconcile against (never duplicate) the curated Wikidata-sourced edges — each row carrying CC-BY-SA-3.0 and admitted into the SHARE-ALIKE OVERLAY tier, kept distinct from the permissive core so its duty is not propagated onto CC-BY/CC0 records.

The 109 range-polygon source is executed and the ingested GeoJSON attaches to language nodes by glottocode/ISO, moving the /api/data-quality `language-range-polygons` coverage above 133/200 toward the 200 target (the run records exactly how far the source closes it if it lands short).
`bun run convergence-qa` and `.chief/verify.sh` pass on the combined data change; `uv run --all-packages pytest -q engine/tests services/api/tests` stays green.

userStories.title: Re-baseline, regenerate every pinned snapshot, and verify coverage and tiers
userStories.description: Complete the node-lexicon-change cascade: regenerate all committed snapshots and the lugh-checkout manifests, re-baseline convergence-QA, and verify both the domain coverage the population run was for and the licence-tier composition the grown corpus now carries.
acceptanceCriteria: All committed snapshots the data change cascades into are regenerated and in sync: `npx tsx scripts/export-for-engine.ts` (docs/engine-export-manifest.json), `npx tsx scripts/reconciliation-report.ts` (docs/reconciliation-report.json), `npx tsx scripts/coverage-report.ts` (docs/coverage-report.{json,md}), the corpus-tier report, the convergence-QA baseline (docs/convergence-qa-baseline.json) where counts legitimately moved, and the entity-grounding/insimul fixture packs if their shape moved — the live-corpus parity tests all pass.

The corpus-tier report additionally reports the LICENCE-tier composition after the run (permissive core / share-alike overlay / non-commercial / unknown record counts), and the count of `unknown` rows has not increased — a growth in `unknown` means a source was ingested without a verified licence and is a failure, not a note.

The cross-repo lugh cascade is executed in the sibling lugh checkout in order (pinakes-export-triples, -verbalizations, -kgqa, then -queries, then pinakes-eval-kgqa, per scripts/CLAUDE.md) so lugh's manifest tests are green against the grown corpus, not silently skipping, and the exports select on the stored tier so no share-alike or non-commercial row reaches lugh's permissive-core training corpus; the run is recorded (lugh commits happen in lugh, not here).

/api/data-quality reports the post-run domain coverage — 15/15 Phase-15 domains at target if 109's source fully closes language-range-polygons, else the honest residual is recorded in the coverage report + ROADMAP row; `.chief/verify.sh` passes.
